items.new: Soon the spyglass showed from the stranger's boats and manned mastheads that she was a whale-ship. items.new: It is worth adding here, in parentheses, that among the fatal accidents of the Sperm-Whale Fishery, this kind is perhaps nearly as common as any. Sometimes nothing is hurt except the man who is wiped out this way; more often the bow of the boat is knocked off, or the thigh-board where the headsman (the officer commanding the boat) stands is torn loose and goes along with the body. But strangest of all is the fact that more than once, when the body has been recovered, not a single mark of violence could be found on it — and yet the man was stone dead.

items.new: From the ship the whole disaster, including Macey's falling body, was clearly visible. With a piercing shriek — "The vial! the vial!" — Gabriel called the terrified crew off from any further pursuit of the whale. This terrible event gave the archangel still more influence, because his gullible disciples believed he had predicted this very thing, rather than having merely made a general prophecy, which anyone could have done, and so happened to hit one of the many targets its wide margin allowed. He became a nameless terror to the ship.

items.new: I have hinted that I often had to jerk poor Queequeg out from between the whale and the ship, where he would sometimes fall because of the ceaseless rolling and swaying of both. But that was not the only crushing danger he faced. Not at all put off by the slaughter inflicted on them during the night, the rabid sharks, now drawn afresh and more keenly by the blood that had been pent up until then and was starting to flow from the carcass, swarmed around it like bees in a hive.

items.new: English legal writers name two royal fish — the whale and the sturgeon — both of them royal property within certain limits, and in name supplying the tenth branch of the crown's ordinary revenue. I am not aware that any other author has touched on the matter, but it seems to me by inference that the sturgeon must be divided the same way as the whale, the King getting that fish's peculiarly dense and elastic head — which, taken symbolically, may possibly be humorously grounded in some supposed kinship. And so there seems to be a reason for everything, even in law.
